title: Practice 1: Instrumental endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Том был ___ (окружный, instr. sg. m.) шерифом.
exercises.prompt: Tom was a county sheriff.
exercises.why: **окружный → окружным** (instr. sg. m., agreeing with шерифом). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): I. новым. Ending -ый → -ым.  Declension of окружный (m.): окружный · окружного · окружному · окружный (inan.) / окружного (anim.) · окружным · окружном; plural: окружные · окружных · окружным · окружные (inan.) / окружных (anim.) · окружными · окружных.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том не обладает ___ (лидерский, instr. pl.) качествами.
exercises.prompt: Tom doesn't have what it takes to be a good leader.
exercises.why: **лидерский → лидерскими** (instr. pl., agreeing with качествами). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings): I. русскими. Ending -ие → -ими.  Declension of лидерский (plural): лидерские · лидерских · лидерским · лидерские (inan.) / лидерских (anim.) · лидерскими · лидерских.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Если бы не его леность, он бы был ___ (славный, instr. sg. n.) малым.
exercises.prompt: If it were not for his idleness, he would be a nice fellow.
exercises.why: **славный → славным** (instr. sg. n., agreeing with малым). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): I. новым. Ending -ое → -ым. exercises.q: В лесу, под ___ (старый, instr. sg. f.) липой, был колодец.
exercises.prompt: In the forest, under an old linden tree, there was a well.
exercises.why: **старый → старой** (instr. sg. f., agreeing with липой). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): I. новой. Ending -ая → -ой.  Declension of старый (f.): старая · старой · старой · старую · старой · старой; plural: старые · старых · старым · старые (inan.) / старых (anim.) · старыми · старых.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. In spite of -ш-, «большая» belongs to the guttural type: большой, большую.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Япония является ___ (крупный, instr. sg. m.) импортёром американской сельскохозяйственной продукции.
exercises.prompt: Japan is the largest importer of U.S. farm products.
exercises.why: **крупный → крупнейшим** (instr. sg. m., agreeing with импортёром). «крупнейшим» is a degree form (comparative / superlative) of крупный, not its plain form, so no ending is compared with the plain declension.    «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
